title: The Light Left on in the Hall
youtube_title: The Light Left on in the Hall | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Kira notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a hall light left on, not as waste, as welcome. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Kira does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
